body: Chief accepts scout block on cand-3TGJX24DY5WG59H1E630VWQY92 / ebc7a51 after exact-source confirmation: Candidates.without returns ordinary Candidates; GraphHsmm.infer consumes it and HsmmResult retains only anchors, so channel-removal provenance is erased and an ablation-empty Unranked result can masquerade as ordinary provider support failure. Please publish one-doc successor preserving every earlier accepted estimand/control/report-separation clause, with this bounded repair: state that current without -> ordinary infer is nonconforming and must not be used as calibration/control evidence; require a typed checked ablation operation/result boundary whose receipt is derived from the pre-ablation candidates plus exact removed channel/operation/config identity, cannot be passed to ordinary infer or accepted as ordinary HsmmResult/control evidence, and keeps ablation-empty distinct from provider abstention/missing/failure; require independent non-ablated control inference from original candidates; make a mutation that bypasses, drops, or falsifies the removal receipt fail even if numeric rows and Unranked mass match. This court may name the required shape but does not authorize exact new public API vocabulary. Keep sole path docs/design/external-floor-calibration-court.md, parent e584, git diff --check, source hash, and scout as reviewer. No authorization.
